name: wrapper-root-gitroot-repair-ux
title: Add wrapper-root gitRoot repair UX
description: Add a small deterministic Lattice CLI UX for projects where metadataRoot is a wrapper directory and the actual git-backed signed workspace is a nested child repository. The CLI should diagnose the layout, suggest an explicit gitRoot configuration when there is exactly one safe child git repo candidate, and provide a confirmed repair command that validates and writes gitRoot. It must stay host-neutral: hosts may execute the command, but Lattice owns the diagnosis and config write; no Claude/Codex auto-repair, no silent repository choice, no broad optimization, and no authority/production policy expansion.

riskSignalsDismissed.reason: False positive: production appears only in the excluded-scope boundary saying this story must not change authority or production readiness policy; the implementation is limited to config diagnostics and explicit repair UX.
